SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, count(*) n, min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc), min(dispatch_ts_utc), max(dispatch_ts_utc), count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-25' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-10' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END ch, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id)) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, sum(net_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id) atv,
  count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) dl
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY ALL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rec FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) net, sum(receipts) rec FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.net mine, c.net ctl, m.net-c.net diff, m.rec, c.rec
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0))>0.5 OR m.rec<>c.rec OR m.store_id IS NULL OR c.store_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) ns, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) nd, count(DISTINCT f.staff_purchase_flag) nf
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-08-05' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) receipts, sum(CASE WHEN ns>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_store, sum(CASE WHEN nd>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_date, sum(CASE WHEN nf>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mixed_staff FROM x

SELECT count(*) orders, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN f.cnt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines, sum(CASE WHEN f.cnt<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) cnt FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code IS NOT NULL OR channel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

),

  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_eur,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
